meta.title_en: Check the network before you withdraw
meta.hook_zh: 提币选错网络，还能找回吗？

cta.line_zh: 在 NexuAlpha 的 Telegram 领取"提币前五项检查"清单，每次提币前对照一遍。
cta.line_en: Get the "five checks before you withdraw" list on NexuAlpha's Telegram and run through it before every withdrawal.

meta.review_notes: 复用试播集 01《转币前核对网络》的结构与措辞（接收方优先、两边网络一致、核对开头和末尾、Memo/Tag、五项检查、'网络先，地址后，确认一次'），中文为主。沿用'可能无法找回'，不说一律不可恢复。新增事实：TRON Base58 地址以 T 开头（TRON 开发者文档）；以太坊地址以 0x 开头（ethereum.org），并提醒 BNB Smart Chain 等兼容链地址同样以 0x 开头，所以开头字符不能代替选网络。小额测试与 TxID 查询依据 OKX 帮助中心。Telegram CTA 无合作链接。

scenes.voice_zh: "提币的时候选错了网络，钱还能找回来吗？"可能找不回。所以发送之前，先停在"网络"这一栏。
scenes.voice_en: "I picked the wrong network when withdrawing. Can I get it back?" Maybe not. So before you send, stop at the network field.
scenes.title: 先停在网络栏
scenes.sub: 选错网络，可能无法找回

params.note: 原创示意画面，非真实界面

scenes.voice_zh: 同一种资产，可能存在于不同的区块链上。比如 USDT，可以走以太坊网络，也可以走波场网络。两条路不能混用。
scenes.voice_en: The same asset can live on different blockchains. USDT, for example, may move on Ethereum or on Tron. Those routes are not interchangeable.
scenes.title: 一种资产，多条网络

scenes.voice_zh: 先打开接收平台，选好币种，看它当前支持哪个充值网络。以接收平台当前的说明为准。
scenes.voice_en: Open the receiving platform first. Choose the asset and read which deposit network it supports right now. Treat its current instructions as the source of truth.
scenes.title: 先看接收方
scenes.sub: 以接收平台当前说明为准

params.screen: 接收平台 · 充值 USDT

scenes.voice_zh: 再回到发送平台，选择同一个网络。不要只因为手续费低，就改选别的网络。
scenes.voice_en: Then go back to the sending platform and choose the same network. Never switch networks just because the fee is lower.
scenes.title: 两边网络一致
scenes.sub: 不因手续费低而换网络

scenes.voice_zh: 地址开头也能帮你检查。波场地址以 T 开头，以太坊地址以 0x 开头。但其他兼容链也是 0x，所以开头不能代替选网络。
scenes.voice_en: The start of the address helps too. Tron addresses begin with T, Ethereum addresses with 0x. But other compatible chains also use 0x, so the prefix can't replace choosing the network.
scenes.title: 看地址开头

scenes.voice_zh: 从接收平台复制地址，粘贴后核对开头和末尾几位。如果要求填 Memo 或 Tag，也必须填上。
scenes.voice_en: Copy the address from the receiver, paste it, and check the first and last characters. If a memo or tag is required, fill it in too.
scenes.title: 核对地址与 Memo

params.screen: 发送平台 · 提币确认

scenes.voice_zh: 第一次往新地址转账，先发一小笔测试。发出后，可以用交易哈希，也就是 TxID，在区块浏览器上查看状态。
scenes.voice_en: When sending to a new address for the first time, send a small test first. Once it's sent, you can look up its status on a block explorer with the transaction ID, the TxID.
scenes.title: 先小额测试

scenes.voice_zh: 提交前五项复核：币种、网络、地址、Memo、金额。网络先，地址后，确认一次。核对清楚，比点得快更重要。
scenes.voice_en: Five checks before you submit: asset, network, address, memo, amount. Network first. Address next. Confirm once. Checking carefully matters more than speed.
scenes.title: 网络先，地址后

page.summary_zh: 提币选错网络，资产可能无法找回，能否找回取决于资产、网络、钱包控制权和接收平台的支持情况。正确顺序是：先在接收平台查看当前支持的充值网络，再在发送平台选择同一网络，核对地址开头和末尾，需要时填写 Memo/Tag。波场地址以 T 开头、以太坊地址以 0x 开头，但其他兼容链也用 0x，所以地址开头不能代替选择网络。第一次转到新地址先小额测试，并用 TxID 查询状态。
checklist_zh: 已在接收平台确认当前支持的充值网络
发送平台选择了同一网络
核对了地址开头和末尾几位
需要 Memo / Tag 的已填写
新地址先发一小笔测试
提交前复核币种、网络、地址、Memo、金额

quiz.q: 提币时，网络应该以谁的说明为准？
options: 接收平台当前的充值说明
quiz.answer: 接收平台当前的充值说明
quiz.why: 接收方支持哪个网络，决定了你应该选哪个网络。

quiz.q: 地址以 0x 开头，能确定是以太坊网络吗？
options: 能，所有地址都以 0x 开头
quiz.why: BNB Smart Chain 等兼容链地址同样以 0x 开头，所以必须以网络选项为准。

quiz.q: 第一次往新地址转大额，稳妥的做法是？
quiz.why: 小额测试到账后再转剩余部分，出错时损失更小。

faq.q: 提币选错网络能找回吗？
faq.a: 视情况而定。取决于资产、网络、你是否控制接收地址的私钥、以及接收平台是否支持找回。有的可以，有的无法找回。不要相信要求先付费的"找回服务"。

faq.q: TRC20 和 ERC20 有什么区别？
faq.a: 它们是 USDT 在不同区块链上的版本：TRC20 在波场（Tron）上，地址以 T 开头；ERC20 在以太坊上，地址以 0x 开头。两者不能混用。
TxID 是链上交易的编号。把它粘贴到对应网络的区块浏览器里，可以看到交易是否已确认、转到了哪个地址。

page.summary_en: If you choose the wrong withdrawal network, assets may not be recoverable. Whether recovery is possible depends on the asset, network, wallet control, and receiving platform support. The correct order is: first check the receiving platform's currently supported deposit network; then choose the same network on the sending platform; check the beginning and end of the address; and fill in Memo or Tag when required. Tron addresses start with T and Ethereum addresses start with 0x, but other compatible chains also use 0x, so address prefixes cannot replace network selection. For a new address, send a small test first and use the TxID to check status.
checklist_en: I confirmed the currently supported deposit network on the receiving platform
I selected the same network on the sending platform
I checked the first and last characters of the address
I filled in Memo / Tag if required
I sent a small test amount to a new address first
Before submitting, I rechecked asset, network, address, Memo, and amount

quiz_en.q: When withdrawing, whose network instructions should you follow?
options: The receiving platform's current deposit instructions
The network with the lowest fee
quiz_en.answer: The receiving platform's current deposit instructions
quiz_en.why: The network supported by the receiver determines which network you should choose.

quiz_en.q: If an address starts with 0x, can you be sure it is Ethereum?
options: No, other compatible chains also use 0x
quiz_en.answer: No, other compatible chains also use 0x
quiz_en.why: BNB Smart Chain and other compatible chains also use 0x addresses, so the network option must be the source of truth.

quiz_en.q: For a large first transfer to a new address, what is safer?
options: Skip Memo to make it faster
quiz_en.why: Send a small test and wait for it to arrive before sending the rest. If something is wrong, the loss is smaller.

faq_en.q: Can a wrong-network withdrawal be recovered?
faq_en.a: It depends on the asset, network, whether you control the receiving private key, and whether the receiving platform supports recovery. Some can be recovered; some cannot. Do not trust “recovery services” that demand payment first.

faq_en.q: What is the difference between TRC20 and ERC20?
faq_en.a: They are USDT versions on different blockchains: TRC20 is on Tron and addresses start with T; ERC20 is on Ethereum and addresses start with 0x. They are not interchangeable.

faq_en.q: What is a TxID and how do I use it?
faq_en.a: A TxID is the transaction identifier on-chain. Paste it into the block explorer for the relevant network to see whether the transaction is confirmed and which address received it.
